name: stop-hook-stdin-block
symptom: Calling stop-hook.mjs directly in PowerShell without piping JSON to stdin hangs forever.
root_cause: stop-hook.mjs calls fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8') on file descriptor 0 (stdin), blocking indefinitely until EOF if no pipe is connected.
prevention: Always pipe JSON into stop-hook.mjs stdin or run gate-check.mjs --approve for gate verification.

name: powershell-quoted-exe-missing-call-operator
symptom: PowerShell throws ParserError: Unexpected token '-c' or similar when invoking a quoted .exe path at the start of a line.
root_cause: In PowerShell, a quoted string at the start of a statement is parsed as a string literal unless preceded by the call operator (&).
prevention: Prepend '& ' before quoted executable paths in PowerShell commands.

name: freellmapi-no-windows-startup
symptom: Adding FreeLLMAPI to Windows Startup bloats laptop boot time.
root_cause: Operator explicitly mandated zero Windows Startup entries for FreeLLMAPI; it must only launch on-demand when port 3001 is called.
prevention: Use c:\Users\avich\Downloads\mythos\freellmapi\ensure-freellmapi.js (WMI Win32_Process.Create on-demand launcher) instead of Windows Startup.

name: windows-sync-spawn-handle-inheritance
symptom: Spawning a persistent background daemon from inside a synchronous hook on Windows causes the parent spawnSync call to hang until timeout.
root_cause: Windows child processes spawned via Node child_process.spawn can inherit stdout/stderr pipe handles from synchronous parent hooks.
prevention: Launch persistent background daemons on Windows via WMI Win32_Process.Create (ShowWindow=0) so zero stdio handles are inherited.

name: embeddinggemma2-fp16-nan
symptom: EmbeddingGemma 2 returns NaN or silently degraded embeddings when loaded in float16.
root_cause: EmbeddingGemma 2's activation range exceeds the dynamic range of IEEE 754 float16 (5-bit exponent).
prevention: Always run google/embeddinggemma-2 in torch.bfloat16 (CUDA) or torch.float32 (CPU), never torch.float16.

name: reference-image-forensic-8-axis
symptom: Generated AI replacement images fail to match the exact pose, hex palette, and graphic artwork of the reference image.
root_cause: Synthesizing prompts from product titles instead of extracting all 8 visual axes from the reference image first.
prevention: Inspect the reference image via read_file, run 'cli-anything-google-vids --json prompt from-image <ref>', generate, strip watermark via gwr.mjs, and verify side-by-side.

name: gravitas-read-before-edit-invariant
symptom: Blindly editing an existing file without reading its current lines causes target mismatch or overwrites adjacent logic.
root_cause: Mutating a file from memory or stale context instead of inspecting current file contents first.
prevention: Always read the target file in the current session before calling edit_file or overwriting it.

name: gravitas-never-exact-retry-failure
symptom: Retrying the exact byte-identical failing command or edit wastes tokens and repeats the same error.
root_cause: Re-running a failed tool call without inspecting state or modifying arguments.
prevention: Inspect error output, read the relevant state/file, and change the command or arguments before retrying.
